cases.name: left_using
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id AS id FROM rental LEFT JOIN customer USING (customer_id)
cases.reason: The merged key is the preserved side, including unmatched rows; the other key is a join dependency only.

cases.name: left_on
cases.sql: SELECT rental.customer_id AS id FROM rental LEFT JOIN customer ON rental.customer_id=customer.customer_id
cases.reason: Equivalent explicit ON form of the USING query.

cases.name: right_using
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id AS id FROM rental RIGHT JOIN customer USING (customer_id)
cases.reason: The merged key is the preserved side, including unmatched rows; the other key is a join dependency only.

cases.name: right_on
cases.sql: SELECT customer.customer_id AS id FROM rental RIGHT JOIN customer ON rental.customer_id=customer.customer_id
cases.reason: Equivalent explicit ON form of the USING query.

cases.name: full_using
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id AS id FROM rental FULL JOIN customer USING (customer_id)
cases.reason: A FULL JOIN merged key coalesces both physical input keys.

cases.name: full_coalesce
cases.sql: SELECT coalesce(rental.customer_id,customer.customer_id) AS id FROM rental FULL JOIN customer ON rental.customer_id=customer.customer_id
cases.reason: Explicit coalesce is equivalent to the FULL JOIN USING output.

cases.name: window_inline
cases.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date) AS position FROM payment
cases.reason: Partition and ordering keys determine each row number.

cases.name: window_named
cases.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER ranking AS position FROM payment WINDOW ranking AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date)
cases.reason: Naming the same window must not change its input dependencies or value lineage.

cases.name: window_inherited
cases.sql: SELECT row_number() OVER ranking AS position FROM payment WINDOW base AS (PARTITION BY customer_id), ranking AS (base ORDER BY payment_date)
cases.reason: A derived window uses its parent partition and its own ordering keys.

cases.name: window_unused
cases.sql: SELECT amount AS total FROM payment WINDOW unused AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date)
cases.reason: An unused window declaration must not flow into an unrelated output value; its declared references still belong to the view.

cases.name: group_alias_collision
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id AS amount FROM payment GROUP BY amount, customer_id ORDER BY amount
cases.reason: GROUP BY resolves an input column before an output alias; ORDER BY resolves the output alias first.

cases.name: latest_payment_lateral
cases.sql: SELECT c.customer_id AS customer, latest.total FROM customer c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT p.amount AS total FROM payment p WHERE p.customer_id=c.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true
cases.reason: The latest amount is a value source; customer matching and ordering are reads only for that output.
